items.a: Emulators imitate Chrome. TestMu AI runs real Chrome browsers online, so rendering, DevTools and extensions match the real version.

items.q: Which Chrome versions can I test?
items.a: Chrome 15 to 159 depending on the operating system; Windows 10 and 11 cover 37 to 159.
